No. The latest frame (18.98s) shows the lower legs and two tan shoes close together at the studio floor; the torso, arms and head are outside the crop.

questions.question: Does the displayed indicator prove this part passed its dimensional tolerance or that the instrument is calibrated?

No—neither dimensional acceptance nor calibration is proved.

A displayed number alone is not necessarily the part’s dimension. Acceptance requires valid measurements compared with the correct drawing tolerances and reviewed by the responsible person.
